articles.title: GEFS on OpenBSD continues to improve

articles.title: Flying an RC Airplane with Twin Airblower EDFs

articles.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
articles.summary: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay.
